- W-9 (for US entities) or equivalent tax doc.
- Point of contact for PO routing & invoice remit.

- Send POs to: billing@redwood.ai and cc: vanessa@redwood.ai for activation priority.

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing - procurement & PO lane

Looping in procurement details from our side. Camila — the typical ask from marketplaces and our finance team is: completed seller form, W-9, signed MSA or click-through T&Cs (marketplace dependent), and PO referencing the Redwood deal number. For CloudPulse specifically, please confirm whether they will list us as a marketplace listing (we become the seller) or a reseller flow — that changes invoicing.

I'm attaching the standard evidence pack we hand to procurement teams: SOC2 summary + DPA checklist. If CloudPulse needs an official SOC2 report, we can route through security for the access request.

Marketplace-specific notes:
- AWS: ask for "Seller ID" field on their intake — we provide the marketplace SKU mapping after PO is received.
- GCP: requires billing account ID to set up listing; PO should reference billing contact.
- Azure: sometimes requires a marketplace procurement partner form (different from our seller intake).

Attachments: Redwood_Procurement_Evidence.zip (attachment stub), SOC2-summary.pdf (attachment stub)

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
